study type: secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
cohort: 1,767 women with a singleton gestation and preterm PROM enrolled in the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network Beneficial Effects of Antenatal Magnesium Sulfate (1997-2004) trial
finding: Even after controlling for gestational age and route of delivery, noncephalic fetuses in the setting of preterm PROM are at greater risk of neonatal death.
